name: clew
description: Index a C, C++ or Python repository into a queryable graph — symbols, call edges, callbacks, threads, locks, dataflow, requirement links and prose — and serve it over MCP. Installs four tools AND one PostToolUse hook that prints a constant one-line reminder once per session after Bash/Grep/Glob (disable with CLEW_HOOK_DISABLE=1). Requires the clew-trace package on PATH and the doxygen binary.
